scope: Proposition 12.6 (Chronological endpoint modulus) of the manuscript “Metric-measure limits of subcritical FK and spanning-tree planar maps” (preprints/Metric-measure-limits-of-subcritical-FK-and-spanning-tree-planar-maps-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1dd659698d3a3fde), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 161. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Equation (12.3) and Proposi- tion 12.3. In a bilateral contour coupling, let J be a compact time interval whose limiting curve image has a neighborhood compactly contained in an open set U. Then, for every deterministic δn ↓ 0, 1 B(n) sup i,j∈nJ∩Z |i−j|≤nδn dGn,U vn(i), vn(j)  −→ 0 in probability. The assertion also holds locally on the event that the stated compact-containment condition is satisfied, by exhausting its clearance and the chronological and spatial compactness cutoffs.
